title: E0003: Method modifiers
plain_english: Methods in classes should declare an explicit visibility modifier: `public`, `protected`, or `private`.
why_matters: Without an explicit modifier, it is less clear whether a method is intended for external use or internal class behavior. Explicit visibility makes the class interface easier to understand and supports encapsulation.
what_it_checks: Class methods that do not declare `public`, `protected`, or `private`.
